categories.prompt: Name a curse, sickness or affliction
categories.blurb: What ails the Isles: rot, blight, curses, addictions and one very bad tummy ache.

categories.prompt: Name something with "Ale" in its name
categories.blurb: Aleforge counts. So does anything else that has "Ale" in it.

categories.prompt: Name something from Aleforge's founding and early history
categories.blurb: Before the Middle Kings: the deity, the spring, the first offices and the first crowns.

categories.prompt: Name an Aleforge local
categories.blurb: Anyone who lives or works in Aleforge, past or present. Not a Liquor King.

categories.prompt: Name an Aleforge official or office-holder
categories.blurb: Mayors, advisors, sheriffs, comptrollers, Color Guard captains. Past or present.

categories.prompt: Name a place in Aleforge
categories.blurb: Buildings, streets and landmarks in the brewing capital of the Isles.

categories.prompt: Name a kind of animal mentioned in the lore
categories.blurb: Species, not names: goat, not CUMsock.

categories.prompt: Name an animal from the lore
categories.blurb: Pets, mounts, mules, a worm named Clancy, and one very unlucky cow. Not monsters.

categories.prompt: Name someone who betrayed someone
categories.blurb: Mutineers, embezzlers, double agents, and one Veilwalker who broke her vow.

categories.prompt: Name a place beyond the Pintland mainland
categories.blurb: Where the Kings came from, passed through, got frozen, or got banished to.

categories.prompt: Name a business or company
categories.blurb: Corporations, shops, papers and farms. Anyone selling something.

categories.prompt: Name a holiday, keg-day or season
categories.blurb: Anything on the Pintland calendar: the nine days of the Keg, the three seasons, or a feast.

categories.prompt: Name something with a colour in its name
categories.blurb: Red, gold, black, green, blue, amber, white, copper, ivory…

categories.prompt: Name something from the Cloister Beast concept

categories.prompt: Name something from Horror in Hoegaarden
categories.blurb: Missing interns, a dungeon under a library, and the prison of the Rotted Soul.

categories.prompt: Name something from the Liquor King Trials

categories.prompt: Name something from Stewards of Aleforge

categories.prompt: Name something from the Walk of Shame
categories.blurb: How six strangers met in Drycup Forest and made their way to the Pintland Isles.

categories.prompt: Name a creature, beast or monster
categories.blurb: Great beasts, small sprites, and everything that chased the Kings through a dark hallway.

categories.prompt: Name a crime
categories.blurb: Embezzlement to apostasy, with a side of jaywalking.

categories.prompt: Name something tied to John Cum or the Cumstead
categories.blurb: The great wheat farm, the family behind it, and how it all went wrong.

categories.prompt: Name a cursed, sacred or mysterious site
categories.blurb: Places that hum, whisper, swallow people, or should have stayed sealed.

categories.prompt: Name a character whose name is a dirty joke
categories.blurb: People and animals only. You know the ones.

categories.prompt: Name a book, journal, letter or document
categories.blurb: Anything written down: tomes, diaries, manuals, ledgers, love letters, ransom notes.

categories.prompt: Name a clue from the Gideon Drake investigation
categories.blurb: The letters, diaries, notes and findings the Kings dug up in Stewards of Aleforge.

categories.prompt: Name a drink or brew

categories.prompt: Name something tied to the Drunken Trials

categories.prompt: Name a real-world figure the lore mentions

categories.prompt: Name a historical event or era
categories.blurb: Wars, dynasties, disasters, massacres, trials and one very unfortunate mute button.

categories.prompt: Name a faction, gang or organization

categories.prompt: Name a food

categories.prompt: Name a game, contest or sport

categories.prompt: Name a holiday or festival

categories.prompt: Name a drink on Jameson Pilsner's list

categories.prompt: Name someone or something the Liquor Kings killed
categories.blurb: On purpose, by accident, or by forgetting to open a cage.

categories.prompt: Name something tied to Buke

categories.prompt: Name something tied to Jameson Pilsner

categories.prompt: Name something tied to Seamus Bonehardy
